channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Opinion | Minnesotans seem to be done playing ‘Minnesota Nice’
item.description: We appear to be developing a new state ethos that was encapsulated by the mayor of Minneapolis’ recent use of the F-bomb to denounce ICE.

item.title: Spurs clip Timberwolves 126-123 despite Anthony Edwards’ career-high 55 points
item.description: Edwards scored 26 points in the fourth quarter as the Wolves climbed back from a 25-point halftime deficit, but they couldn’t finish the job vs. Victor Wembanyama and co.

item.title: 3 places to get iconic Minnesota chicken wild rice soup
item.description: Our unofficial state soup brims with pride and rich comfort.

item.title: Jake Lang’s anti-Islam rally chased off by Minneapolis protesters
item.description: Below-zero windchills didn’t deter hundreds of protesters rallying against Lang and his handful of supporters in downtown Minneapolis.

item.title: Worry over ICE builds in Twin Cities suburbs as confrontations go viral
item.description: City Council meetings are drawing crowds of residents airing their views on ICE operations. City leaders say they’re limited in what they can do.

item.title: Transit providers say fraud claims could threaten a struggling industry, especially in rural Minnesota
item.description: Thousands of Minnesotans rely on the Medicaid-funded transportation program to get to medical appointments.

item.title: Why videos of ICE in Minnesota are a ‘breakthrough moment’ online
item.description: Most news events don’t widely register in the public consciousness. Experts say it’s different with the killing of Renee Good and the ICE surge in Minnesota.

item.title: Federal judge bars ICE agents from ‘retaliating’ against protesters in Minnesota
item.description: The injunction filed Jan. 16 follows a lawsuit brought by six Minnesota residents during the early days of Operation Metro Surge last month.

item.title: Walz, Frey reportedly under investigation by U.S. Department of Justice
item.description: Both DFL leaders characterized any investigation as an intimidation tactic. Neither has received anything official from the DOJ.

item.title: The latest: A day of confrontations and clashes in downtown Minneapolis, at federal building
item.description: Federal agents rushed the crowd at the federal building and used chemical irritants a day after a federal judge banned such tactics against peaceful protesters.
